source: 603 Organs Again
target: 603 Organa Iterum

source: The dark-green light morphed into a beam, slamming into the old man’s chest and sinking into the loose black robe, akin to sunlight, unstoppable.
target: Lux viridis obscura in radium mutata, in pectus senis feriens et in laxum atrum pallium immergens, quasi solis radiatio, insuperabilis.

source: Already appearing seven to eight years younger, the old man’s expression twisted, and every inch of exposed skin displayed signs of melting.
target: Iam septem vel octo annos iuvenior apparens, vultus senis contortus est, et omnis pars cutis exposta signa liquefactionis ostendebat.

source: His aura rapidly waned.
target: Aura eius celeriter evanuit.

source: Simultaneously, a burst of vigorous life force erupted from his body.
target: Simul, vis vitalis vehementer ex corpore eius erupit.

source: Under the melting skin, flesh and blood writhed, resisting the mutation.
target: Sub cutis liquefacta, caro et sanguis convoluebantur, mutationi repugnantes.

source: The black-robed old man’s eyes darkened, and he abruptly faded away.
target: Oculi senis obscuraverunt, atque repente evanuit.

source: In an instant, a hazy face emerged from the armchair at the dining table, blending with the brown wood, about to gain clarity.
target: In momento, vultus nebulosus e solio ad mensam cenariam emersit, cum ligno fusco miscens, paene claritatem adepturus.

source: At that moment, a cascade of flames descended from the crimson-flame‐covered ceiling, soaking the armchair and swiftly setting it ablaze.
target: Illo momento, flammae confluentes ex laquearia, coccineo igne tegestae, descenderunt, solium impregnantes et celeriter incendentes.

source: Before the brown face could fully materialize, it succumbed to the raging flames, forced to retreat.
target: Antequam vultus fusci plene appareret, flammarum furoris cecidit, coactus recedere.

source: Lumian lost sight and sense of the black-robed elder subsequently.
target: Lumian postea conspectum et sensum senis in veste atra induti amisit.

source: While surveying the surroundings, Lugano, lying on the dining table, suddenly sat up and jumped down.
target: Circumiecta perspicens, Lugano, in mensa cenaria iacens, subito surrexit et desiluit.

source: He stared at Lumian with vacant eyes, like a wandering zombie.
target: Ad Lumian oculis vacuis, ut ambulans mortuus, aspiciebat.

source: Lumian chuckled, raising his right hand and pointing at Lugano.
target: Lumian subridens dextram manum extulit et ad Lugano indicavit.

source: With this gesture, specks of brilliance shimmered in his eyes, as if the cosmos had descended.
target: Hoc gestu, miculae fulgoribus in oculis eius micabant, quasi cosmos descendisset.

source: Lugano found himself in an empty night sky, surrounded by twinkling stars.
target: Lugano se invenit in caelo nocturno vacuo, circumdatus stellis micantibus.

source: He stood rooted to the ground in a daze. Without any subsequent actions, he resembled a machine that had lost its energy and controller.
target: Stetit radicatus in terra, attonitus. Nulla ulterior opera, instar machinae sine energia et moderatore carentis, videbatur.

source: Having settled his servant, Lumian surveyed his surroundings once more.
target: Servum suum constituto, Lumian circumiecta iterum perspexit.

source: Yet, his eyes brimmed with flowing and burning crimson flames, and the black-robed elder’s figure remained elusive.
target: Attamen, oculi eius replebantur flammis coccineis fluitantibus et ardentibus, et figura senis in veste atra evasiva manebat.

source: Lumian’s expression remained stoic as he splayed the five fingers on his right hand, clenching them into a fist.
target: Vultus Lumiani stoicus remansit, dum quinque digitos dextrae manus extendit et in pugno conclusit.

source: His body suddenly grew heavy, and the flames surrounding him surged towards him like a river converging into the sea, drawn by an invisible force.
target: Corpus eius subito grave factum est, et flammae quae eum circumdabant, instar fluminis in mare confluente, versus eum impulerunt, vi invisibili trahente.

source: Bottles, organs from various body parts, and lightweight items in the room soared towards Lumian.
target: Vascula, organa ex variis partibus corporis, et res leviores in conclavi, versus Lumian volaverunt.

source: On the wooden coat rack near the door, the transparent figure of the black-robed elder protruded, pulled away by an unseen force.
target: In appendice ligneo prope ostium, figura translucida senis in veste atra protuberabat, attrahita a vis invisibili.

source: He fought with all his might, but he couldn’t resist the pull towards Lumian. It was akin to a piece of wood caught in a flood or a thin leaf fluttering in a fierce wind.
target: Omni vi pugnavit, sed vim trahentem eum versus Lumian oppugnare non potuit. Id erat instar ligni raptum in diluvio aut folii tenuis in vento furioso volitante.

source: Lumian’s left hand was already raised, and the crimson, nearly white flame in his palm rapidly turned white under the intense suction force, forming a minuscule ball.
target: Manus sinistra Lumiani iam surrecta erat, et flamma coccinea, paene alba, in palma eius sub intensa vi attrahendi celeriter in albam mutata est, parvum globulum formans.

source: Layers of compressed white-hot fireballs were unleashed, and the weighty and fearsome suction force dissipated.
target: Strata globula ignium albidum, comprimens, emissae sunt, et vis attrahendi grave atque formidolosum evanuit.

source: Pa! The black-robed elder finally landed on the floor, his vision completely engulfed by the blazing white fireball.
target: Pa! Senex in veste atra tandem in solum cecidit, et visus eius a globulo albo incensi omnino absorptus est.

source: Rumble!
target: Tumultus!

source: The blazing white fireball collided with the Beyonder conducting the sinister surgery and strange ritual.
target: Globulus albus incensus cum Beyonder, qui sinistram chirurgiam atque insolitum ritum peragabat, congressus est.

source: The explosion’s sound echoed into the distance but was muffled by the darkness shrouding the room, preventing it from permeating.
target: Sonus explosionis in longinquum resonavit, sed tenebrae, conclavi circumdantes, eum obmutescebant ne perveniret.

source: In the midst of such a violent explosion, no one on the ship heard or sensed anything awry.
target: In medio tali violentae explosionis, nemo in nave quidquam iniuriosum audivit nec sensit.

source: Rumble!
target: Tumultus!

source: The black-robed elder’s body was shredded by the devastating explosion.
target: Corpus senis in veste atra ab explosione devastante diruptum est.

source: Countless corpse fragments were instantly charred or consumed by bright flames, scattering across every corner of the living room and dining room.
target: Innumerabilia cadaverum fragmenta statim exarserunt aut a flammis nitidissimis devorata sunt, per omnem angulum atrii et triclinii disseminata.

source: With spirit channeling at his disposal and Ludwig providing support, Lumian reveled in the authority of the Governor of the Sea and the nearly demigod-level power it bestowed. He cared not for what the enemy might transform into.
target: Cum facultate canalizandi spiritum in promptu et Ludovico auxilium praebente, Lumian in auctoritate Praefecti Maris et in potentia paene semidei, quam illa tribueret, gaudebatur; non curabat quid hostis in formam mutatam caperet.

source: Incredible. Is this what it’s like to be a demigod? Even if it’s just an illusion… Sadly, it won’t last beyond six in the morning… Lumian sighed, directing his gaze at the burning corpse fragments.
target: Incredibile! Num ita est esse semideus? Etiamsi sola illusio sit, infelix est: ultra horam sextam mane non permanebit. Lumian suspiravit et oculos suos ad partes cadaverum ardentium intendit.

source: A quick inspection revealed that the black-robed elder’s flesh had rapidly charred or turned to ashes. It was as if frost had met magma from a volcanic eruption.
target: Examen celerum demonstravit carnem senis in veste atra celeriter combustam esse aut in cinerem redactam. Erat quasi glacies cum magmā eruptionis volcanoae convenisset.

source: In a matter of seconds, only the heart, liver, spleen, lungs, kidneys, intestines, and stomach remained in the room, along with a grayish-white half-charred brain.
target: In paucissimis secundis, tantum cor, iecur, lien, pulmones, renes, intestina, et venter in conclavi remanserunt, una cum cerebro cinereo-albo semi-combusto.

source: Wh… Even with his feet, Lumian could tell that something was awry.
target: Eheu… Etiam per pedes suis, Lumian intellexit aliquid esse erratum.

source: Except for the brain, the remnants of the enemy were all internal organs.
target: Praeter cerebrum, reliquiae hostis omnia erant organa interna.

source: The malevolent surgery he had just completed involved extracting someone’s internal organs to let them live as if nothing happened!
target: Chirurgia nefaria quam modo perfecit constabat in extrahendis internis organis alicuius, ut vixerent quasi nihil evenisset!

source: At the same time, the peculiar ritual he performed utilized the complete set of internal organs to attempt to reconstruct the so‐called Child of God’s body!
target: Simul, ritus peculiaris quem peragebat, tota seriem internorum organorum adhibebat, ut corpus dicti Filii Dei reconstrueret!

source: All internal organs—it was hard for Lumian not to draw a connection.
target: Omnia organa interna — difficile erat Lumiano non quandam nexum trahere.

source: Could it be that this fellow’s internal organs were extracted before, and he survived by piecing together others’ internal organs, becoming a Beyonder? What’s this called? Human alchemy? If it’s true, who took his internal organs? Lumian pondered silently.
target: Num fieri potest ut organa interna huius hominis ante extraherentur, et ipse aggregando interna aliorum superesset, factus Beyonder?

source: The stars in his eyes swiftly dissipated, and Lugano returned to the real world.
target: Stellae in oculis eius celeriter evanuerunt, et Lugano ad rem veram rediit.

source: From a distance of four to five meters, Lumian raised his right hand and smoothly swung it.
target: Ex distantia quattuor ad quinque metrorum, Lumian dextram manum extulit et leniter circumiecit.

source: Smack!
target: Ictus!

source: Lugano felt the impact of an invisible force against his face.
target: Lugano impulsum vis invisibilis in faciem suam sensit.

source: With a sudden jolt, his eyes gradually cleared of their blank stare.
target: Subito impetu, oculi eius paulatim e vultu vacuo eliberati sunt.

source: The first sight that greeted Lugano was the crimson flames falling around him, extinguishing before causing any havoc.
target: Prima vis quae Lugano occurrit, erant flammae coccineae circa eum cadentes, extinctae antequam cladem intulerent.

source: Then, he noticed charred body parts, scattered internal organs, glass jars filled with light-amber liquid, and organs soaked in them.
target: Deinde animadvertit partes corporis combustas, organa interna dispersa, urnae vitreae liquore aureo leviter repletae, et organa in eis imbuta.

source: Am I still dreaming? Is this a nightmare?
target: Num adhuc somnio? Estne hoc somnium nocturnum?

source: Just as this thought crossed Lugano’s mind, the image of his employer, Louis Berry, with black hair and green eyes, appeared before him.
target: Cum haec cogitatio Lugano menti pertransisset, imago patroni eius, Ludovicus Berry, capillis nigris et oculis viridibus, ante eum apparuit.

source: Son of a bitch, this dream took an unexpected turn! Lugano shuddered and involuntarily inquired, “What happened?”
target: Filius canis, hoc somnium in inopinatum versum vertit!

source: Lumian pondered for a moment and asked, “What dream did you just experience?”
target: Lumian paulisper meditatus est et rogavit: “Quod somnium modo experitus es?”

source: What dream? Lugano confirmed his wakefulness and recollected, “I dreamed of my childhood. My mother stood at the door, urging me to come home for dinner. She even sang a nursery rhyme from my hometown…
target: “Quid somnium?

source: “She’s been gone for almost ten years. I miss her dearly. I kept walking towards the door, but I couldn’t reach her…”
target: Ea fere decem annos abfuit; eam valde desidero.

source: At that moment, Lugano realized that this wasn’t their suite. He exclaimed in shock,
target: Illo momento, Lugano cernens intellexit hanc non esse eorum conclave.

source: “What happened?”
target: “Quid accidit?”

source: With a smile, Lumian responded, “You slept until midnight and suddenly sleepwalked all the way here. An old man had plans to operate on you, remove your kidneys, and slowly turn you into a patient like Enio.”
target: Cum risu, Lumian respondit: “Dormi ad mediam noctem et subito somnambulans huc perrexisisti. Senex consilium habebat te operandi, renes tollendi, et te paulatim in aegrotum, qualem Enio, converteri.”

source: The more Lugano listened, the more fear gripped him. Earlier, he had wondered how someone like Enio, who had lost most of his internal organs, could still be alive, albeit turning weak—only to realize that he was so close to turning into a similar figure!
target: Quo magis Lugano audiebat, eo magis timor eum oppressit.

source: “Hiss…” Lugano gasped and asked with trepidation, “Where’s that old man?”
target: “Hiss…” Lugano exclamavit et timide interrogavit: “Ubi est ille senex?”

source: “That’s all that remains.” Lumian gestured at the internal organs and the grayish-white, half-charred brain on the ground.
target: “Hoc solum remanet.”

source: Without giving Lugano a chance to sigh, Lumian instructed, “Bring Ludwig here.”
target: Sine Lugano tempore suspirandi, Lumian imperavit: “Adducite Ludovicum huc!”

source: It was also almost time for his midnight snack.
target: Iam fere tempus erat ad cenam mediam noctem parare.

source: Lugano hastily left the suite, grateful for choosing to follow Lumian to the Southern Continent.
target: Lugano festinanter conclave reliquit, gratus quod Lumian se ad Continens Meridionalem secutus esset.

source: Otherwise, he would be at the mercy of such situations elsewhere!
target: Alioquin, alibi talibus casibus subiectus futurus esset!

source: Lugano believed this matter had nothing to do with Lumian. He had brought it upon himself. If it were Trier, he might have encountered a similar patient who had lost internal organs.
target: Lugano credebat hanc rem nihil ad Lumian pertinere; ipse eam sibi attulit.

source: Lumian watched him leave, raised his right hand, and stroked his chin.
target: Lumian eum discedentem spectavit, dextram manum extulit, et mentum suum leniter tetigit.

source: Simply hearing the infant’s cries from the failed ritual can influence Beyonders of the Planter pathway to sleep and act in a sleepwalking state, receiving corresponding orders?
target: Sola audientia infantis clamorum ex ritu defuncto, posset influere Beyonderos semitas Plantatoris, ut dormiant atque in somnambulismo verserentur, mandata congrua accipiendos?

source: Isn’t this too exaggerated? It’s an absolute suppression on the Planter pathway…
target: Nonne hoc nimis exaggeratum est? Est absoluta repressio in semita Plantatoris…

source: I could understand a similar phenomenon if that ritual had succeeded, and the Child of God was truly born. Yet, it’s already this powerful despite being a failed product?
target: Potuero intellegere simile phaenomenon, si ille ritus successisset et Filius Dei vere natus esset; attamen iam tam potens est, quamvis productum defecerit.

source: Even with the limitation of its range, it’s still terrifying… Is there a key reason I don’t know?
target: Etiam cum limitata sit amplitudo eius, adhuc terribile est…

source: Moreover, can only Beyonders of the Planter or Sower pathways hear the Child of God’s cries? Can the Apothecary pathway, which can interchange with the Planter pathway, also hear it?
target: Praeterea, num solum Beyonderes semitarum Plantatoris aut Satorum Filii Dei clamores audire possunt?

source: Amidst Lumian’s thoughts, Lugano led Ludwig into the suite.
target: Inter Lumiani cogitationes, Lugano Ludovicum in conclave duxit.

source: Faced with this gruesome scene, Ludwig pressed his hand to his mouth and yawned.
target: Ludwig manum ad os suum premit et os suum patefecit.

source: “Where’s the food?”
target: “Ubi est cibus?”

source: Lumian didn’t make any immediate requests. Instead, he turned to Lugano.
target: Lumian non statim aliquid postulavit; sed conversus est ad Lugano.

source: “Guard the door.”
target: “Custodi ostium.”

source: With the prior experience of the blood-drinking incident, Lugano could vaguely guess what was about to happen. He didn’t dare face it directly. Upon hearing Lumian’s instructions, he heaved a sigh of relief and jogged to the corridor, closing the vermilion door behind him.
target: Experientia priorum rerum sanguine sorbendarum, Lugano vago suspicari potuit quid futurum esset; non ausus est illud directe oppugnare.

source: Only then did Lumian gesture towards the scattered internal organs on the ground.
target: Tum demum Lumian ad organa interna in terra dispersa digitum movit.

source: “Do you need me to roast it for you?”
target: “Visne ut id tibi assam?”

source: Ludwig shot a quick glance at Lumian.
target: Ludwig celeriter ad Lumian conspexit.

source: “Don’t you find it irksome? These are all human organs.”
target: “Num non molestum censes? Haec omnia sunt organa humana.”

source: Lumian emitted a soft chuckle.
target: Lumian leniter subridens edidit.

source: “In my eyes, this is already on par with a monster’s insides.”
target: “In oculis meis, hoc iam par est interioribus monstri.”

source: He then wore a self-deprecating expression.
target: Deinde vultus eius, se ipsum deminuens, apparuit.

source: “Moreover, isn’t directly consuming Beyonder characteristics to advance a Beyonder equivalent to eating someone?”
target: “Praeterea, num directe sumere proprietates Beyonderorum ad Beyonder promovendum non aequivalet edendi aliquem?”

source: Ludwig remained silent, taking a few steps to the side.
target: Ludwig in silentio remansit, paucis passibus ad latus ambulans.

source: He squatted down, picked up the old man’s heart, stuffed it into his mouth, and began to chew.
target: Ludwig genu flectens, cor senis sustulit, in os suum intulit, et masticare coepit.

source: Crimson blood slowly trickled from the corner of his mouth.
target: Sanguis coccineus lente ex angulo oris eius stillabat.

source: Lumian pulled up a chair and sat down, patiently waiting for Ludwig to finish his meal and digest.
target: Lumian sellam arripuit et consedit, patienter exspectans ut Ludwig cenam finiret et digereret.

source: After seven to eight minutes, Ludwig retrieved a white handkerchief from his coat pocket and wiped his mouth.
target: Post septem ad octo minuta, Ludwig ex sinu pallii candidum sudarium extraxit et os suum exterruit.

source: “These internal organs belong to different people. Some are Beyonders, some are ordinary folks, some old, some teenagers…”
target: “Haec organa interna diversis hominibus pertinent. Quaedam sunt Beyonder, quaedam sunt homines ordinarii, quaedam senes, quaedam iuvenes…”

source: “There are traces of human refinement. The aura of life is rather mixed and impure…”
target: “Vestigia subtilitatis humanae adsunt. Aura vitae satis mixta et impura est…”

source: “They will be controlled and influenced by the refiner…”
target: “Illa regentur et ab refinator afficiuntur…”

source: “Having been refined, the person doesn’t know that he’s been through this.
target: Purgatus, homo nescit se hoc passum esse.

source: He has complete memories of the past. This is something that can’t be achieved by refining an ordinary body.
target: Habet plenam memoriam praeteritorum. Hoc est quod a purgatione corporis ordinarii assequi non potest.

source: He followed Enio on board, hoping to extract the remaining organs and complete the ritual before Enio reached his destination…”
target: Adiunxit Enion in nave, sperans reliqua organa extrahere et ritum complere, priusquam Enio ad finem perveniret…

source: Ludwig recounted the knowledge and memories he had absorbed in a straightforward tone.
target: Ludwig enarravit scientiam et memorias quas absoruerat, voce sincera.
